description.value: Rice 'N Spice is a family-run food court restaurant that has been a downtown Vancouver institution since 1992, blending Sri-Lankan curries with Mediterranean and Southeast Asian flavours. Located on the lower level of Harbour Centre near the edge of historic Gastown, it is known for freshly ground spices, overnight-marinated shawarma, and a commitment to no MSG and no preservatives. Touring cyclists stopping in the core will find a wide range of hearty rice-bowl dishes, including a fully vegan and gluten-free vegetarian line-up.
